definition: Establishing to a stated level of assurance that a claimed identity corresponds to a real subject.
Establishing a new customer or member relationship, including the due diligence that regulation attaches to it.
Maintaining an established identity relationship over time: re-verification, recovery, attribute updates, revocation.
Checking whether a subject meets a stated condition — age, residency, licence, membership — without necessarily identifying them.
Granting, restricting and revoking access to systems, premises or services.
Issuing an authoritative statement about a subject, a product or a process — a diploma, a certificate, an accreditation.
Meeting statutory and regulatory obligations, including record-keeping and supervisory reporting.
Selecting, qualifying and contracting suppliers, and running the purchase-to-pay process.
Establishing provenance and chain of custody for goods and their inputs.
Hiring, employing and offboarding people, and administering their qualifications and entitlements.
Handling requests, incidents and complaints from an existing customer relationship.
Performing and delivering the service the organisation exists to provide.
Maintaining an authoritative register or record and answering queries against it.
Concluding an agreement and applying a signature that binds the parties to it.
Billing for goods or services delivered, and settling the payment that follows.
Judging the creditworthiness or risk of a counterparty before committing to a transaction or a relationship.
Assessing and settling a claim made under a policy, a warranty or a guarantee.
Inspecting and testing that output conforms to a specification before it leaves the organisation.
Examining records, processes or claims against a standard, independently of whoever produced them.
Demonstrating that a product meets the regulatory and standards requirements of the markets it is placed on.
Declaring goods to an authority and clearing them across a border.
Registering, maintaining, servicing and transferring a physical asset over its life.
Measuring and disclosing environmental and social performance, to a regulator or to the market.
Determining, declaring and substantiating a tax obligation.
Obtaining, recording and honouring a subject's permission for data about them to be used.
Releasing data to another party with its origin, integrity and permitted use demonstrable.
Granting and maintaining a benefit, subsidy or allowance once eligibility has been established.
Systematic work to create new knowledge, products or processes.
